text: The company reported higher quarterly profit and raised its full-year revenue outlook after strong demand for its products.
The company will publish its quarterly financial report on Thursday before the market opens.
The manufacturer reported a decline in operating profit as weaker demand and rising costs reduced its margins.
Revenue increased compared with last year, but operating profit fell as higher production costs offset the sales growth.
The bank announced that its annual general meeting will take place in May.
The retailer lowered its earnings forecast after recording a loss for the quarter.
The supplier secured a new multi-year contract expected to increase annual sales.
